json_encode: pretty	return sizeof(explode(json_encode(({ 1, ([ "k": 2 ]) }), 1), "\\n")) > 3;

profile_report: the busy function has the self time, its caller the total	object p; void w1() { p->work(400000); } void w2() { p->spin(2000); } void w3() { p->spin(200000); } @@ p = find_object("/test/prof"); profile_start(200); test_limited("w1", 0); mapping r = profile_report(); mapping by = ([]); foreach (mapping f in r["functions"]) by[f["file"] + ":" + f["function"]] = f; mapping spin = by["/test/prof:spin"] || ([]), work = by["/test/prof:work"] || ([]); return ({ r["running"], spin["self"] > r["time"] / 2, work["total"] >= spin["self"], work["self"] < spin["self"], r["functions"][0]["function"], sort_array(keys(spin), 1) });
